response_text: I like the product overall, but the price feels a little high.
Customer support solved my issue quickly and was very friendly.
The app is confusing in a few places and I could not find settings.
Delivery took longer than expected and the box arrived damaged.
Great quality and easy to use. I would recommend it.
I wish there were better reporting features for my team.
Setup was smooth, but I hit a bug when importing data.
The value is good for the cost and features included.
